messages:
liz: dropping a new mock for the latency dashboard — trying an interactive legend that doubles as a filter + a compact sample-rate scrubber. want quick takes before i hand off to eng. mock: https://figma.com/file/xyz (view only)

ken: skimmed — love the idea of legend-as-filter. two quick questions: 1) does toggle state persist across routes? 2) how does it play with auto-sampling when traffic spikes?

oliver: agree with ken. also worried about discoverability of the scrubber — it's pretty tiny. can we show a tooltip on hover that explains what sampling % means in practice?

liz: good call — proposal: legend state persists per-session (localStorage) and scrubber shows a live token-cost estimate in tooltip. sketch of tooltip copy: "Sampling: 20% — ~0.8x cost, p95 may increase ~10ms for this workload"

tasha: pinging a11y thread — need color choices that work for Deuteranopia. current heatmap uses red->purple which fails contrast at low intensity. suggest switching to a colorblind-safe ramp (blue -> orange) and add a high-contrast mode toggle.

a11y-bot: a11y checklist: 1) color contrast ratio for heatmap cells >= 3:1 for small elements, 4.5:1 for interactive legend items. 2) legend items keyboard-focusable with visible outline. 3) ensure the scrubber is reachable and operable by arrow keys.

jamie: small UX nit on wording in the scrubber tooltip — "Sampling" is vague for some PMs. maybe use "Request sampling rate" and on hover expand: "Controls which percentage of incoming requests are fully evaluated and stored."

ken: implementation thought: if we make legend toggles interactive filters, we should avoid re-running full queries on every toggle. caching + client-side filter for the current time window probably fine. if user changes time window, we refetch.

oliver: +1 for client-side filter. also, for p95 line overlays — can we add a subtle shadow band showing historical variance (p90-p99) when you hover the p95 datapoint? helps interpret regressions.

liz: love that. i'll add a hover state with a faint band and a microcopy: "band = 90-99 percentile range".

tasha: accessibility keyboard flow: tab order should be: time range picker -> global sampling scrubber -> heatmap -> legend -> metrics list. currently mock has legend before heatmap; that might be confusing for screen reader users.

liz: good catch. i'll reorder so scrubber is before visuals and legend is tied to heatmap markup region-wise.

ken: performance question — adding interactive legend + client-side filtering might blow up DOM if heatmap renders thousands of cells. propose we virtualize the grid or render aggregated tiles at low zoom.

a11y-bot: reminder: virtualized cells still need semantic labels exposed to screen readers (aria-label on cell groups) — don't hide content behind canvas without fallback.

jamie: copy tweak for legend items: use short labels + hover explainer. e.g., instead of "p95 latency (ms)", show "p95" and on hover: "95th percentile latency — sensitive to tail spikes". cleaner and saves space.

oliver: question about time range presets: can we add a correlated sampling recommendation? e.g., for >30d window recommend higher sampling to preserve trends; for <1h recommend lower sampling to keep latency low. could be a small helper below the scrubber.

liz: noted. i'll add a helper line: "Recommended sampling for this range: 15% (balances cost & fidelity)" with a link to 'why sampling matters' doc.

ken: final ask for handoff — include: 1) accessible color ramp tokens, 2) microcopy strings, 3) scrubber keyboard interactions and states, 4) client-side filter spec + caching behavior. i'll take the eng-implementation ticket after design handoff.

liz: will update mock and add an exported assets + spec page in Figma. aim to post final here by EOD tomorrow. thanks for the quick feedback :raised_hands:

jamie: tiny follow-up: analytics event names? suggest: `latency.legend.toggle`, `latency.sampling.change`, `latency.scrubber.preview` so product can track usage.

ken: perfect — include event payload examples in the spec: { "legend_key": "route:/api/v1/generate", "state": "off" } (inline JSON)

liz: added to spec. will @ken when it's live. closing thread once i post updates.

ops-bot: deploy scheduled: design-handoff-docs -> staging at 2026-03-30 18:00 UTC

liz: thanks all — will follow up with the Figma link and the exported spec file.
